title: HAW 101 Immersion Library
description: Spend time hearing Hawaiian through the official University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo HAW 101 collection without turning listening into a quiz.

sourceReview.notes: Episode labels are taken from the official Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani HAW 101 podcast page. The app links to that official collection instead of embedding the remote MP3 stream, which avoids the unreliable playback/seeking behavior seen in the in-app player.

activities.support: Start by listening for the overall sound and pacing. Do not worry about catching every word.
activities.audioSourceName: Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani — HAW 101
listeningNotes: Open the official UH Hilo collection and choose the episode listed on this card.
Listen once for the overall flow before focusing on individual words.
Replay or seek freely on the official source. Nothing here is scored.
